sanskrit_shloka:
विशीर्णकार्यकरणो भूतसूक्ष्मैरनावृतः।
विमुक्तकर्मनिगलः सद्य एव विमुच्यते।।51।।
transliteration:
Viśīrṇakāryakaraṇo bhūtasūkṣmairanāvṛtaḥ.
Vimuktakarmanigalaḥ sadya eva vimucyate..51..
translation: “No more conditioned by his gross and subtle bodies, free from the embrace of the gross and subtle elements, released from the charm of actions, such a man gets immediately liberated.”

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: “No more conditioned by his gross and subtle bodies, free from the embrace of the gross and subtle elements, released from the charm of actions, such a man gets immediately liberated.”

sanskrit_shloka:
प्रारब्धकर्मवेगेण जीवन्मुक्तो यदा भवेत्।
किञ्चित्कालमनारब्धकर्मबन्धस्य संक्षये।।52।।
transliteration:
Prārabdhakarmavegeṇa jīvanmukto yadā bhavet.
Kiñcitkālamanārabdhakarmabandhasya saṃkṣaye..52..
translation: “The liberated-in-life, due to the compelling force of those actions that have begun to produce their results (Prarabdha), remains for some time to exhaust them”.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: “The liberated-in-life, due to the compelling force of those actions that have begun to produce their results (Prarabdha), remains for some time to exhaust them”.

sanskrit_shloka:
निरस्तातिशयानन्दं वैष्णवं परमं पदम्।
पुनरावृत्तिरहितं कैवल्यं प्रतिपद्यते।।53।।
transliteration:
Nirastātiśayānandaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ paramaṃ padam.
Punarāvṛttirahitaṃ kaivalyaṃ pratipadyate..53..
translation: “The liberated-in-life comes to gain the State of Absolute Oneness, the never-ending immeasurable Bliss, called the Supreme Abode-of-Vishnu, from wherein there is no return.”

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: “The liberated-in-life comes to gain the State of Absolute Oneness, the never-ending immeasurable Bliss, called the Supreme Abode-of-Vishnu, from wherein there is no return.”

sanskrit_shloka:
इति श्रीमत्परमहंसपरिव्राजकाचार्यस्य
श्रीगोविन्दभगवत्पूज्यपादशिष्यस्य
श्रीमच्छंकरभगवतः कृतौ
वाक्यवृत्तिः समाप्ता।।
transliteration:
Iti śrīmatparamahaṃsaparivrājakācāryasya
Śrīgovindabhagavatpūjyapādaśiṣyasya
Śrīmacchaṃkarabhagavataḥ kṛtau
Vākyavṛttiḥ samāptā..
